technique_name: Research and answer a question about the impact of automated systems on job security.
description: Research shows that automation has had a significant impact on job security worldwide. Automation has replaced many jobs in the manufacturing and other sectors, reducing the demand for manual labor and causing job insecurity. Automation has also enabled businesses to increase productivity, optimize processes and reduce costs.
